prices_general_amount_check.name: prices_general_amount_check
prices_general_amount_check.value: "app"."prices"."location_id" is not null or "app"."prices"."amount_cents" is not null

patients_referral_details_check.name: patients_referral_details_check
patients_referral_details_check.value: "app"."patients"."referral_details_enc" is null or "app"."patients"."referral_source_id" is not null

coverages_insurance_check.name: coverages_insurance_check
coverages_insurance_check.value:
case when "app"."coverages"."type" = 'insurance' then
            "app"."coverages"."insurer_name_enc" is not null and "app"."coverages"."term" is not null
            and (("app"."coverages"."term" = 'coinsurance') = ("app"."coverages"."coinsurance_bp" is not null))
            and (("app"."coverages"."term" = 'coinsurance') = ("app"."coverages"."amount_cents" is null))
          else
            "app"."coverages"."insurer_name_enc" is null and "app"."coverages"."member_id_enc" is null and "app"."coverages"."term" is null
            and "app"."coverages"."amount_cents" is null and "app"."coverages"."coinsurance_bp" is null
          end

encounter_vitals_bp_order.name: encounter_vitals_bp_order
encounter_vitals_bp_order.value: "app"."encounter_vitals"."systolic" is null or "app"."encounter_vitals"."diastolic" is null or "app"."encounter_vitals"."diastolic" < "app"."encounter_vitals"."systolic"

encounter_vitals_bmi_check.name: encounter_vitals_bmi_check
encounter_vitals_bmi_check.value: ("app"."encounter_vitals"."bmi_x10" is null) = ("app"."encounter_vitals"."weight_lb_x100" is null or "app"."encounter_vitals"."height_in_x100" is null)

kiosk_checkins_confirmed.name: kiosk_checkins_confirmed
kiosk_checkins_confirmed.value: "app"."kiosk_checkins"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("app"."kiosk_checkins"."patient_id" is not null and "app"."kiosk_checkins"."encounter_id" is not null)

kiosk_checkins_resolved.name: kiosk_checkins_resolved
kiosk_checkins_resolved.value: ("app"."kiosk_checkins"."status" in ('confirmed', 'discarded')) = ("app"."kiosk_checkins"."resolved_at" is not null and "app"."kiosk_checkins"."resolved_by_membership_id" is not null)

kiosk_devices_active_token.name: kiosk_devices_active_token
kiosk_devices_active_token.value: "app"."kiosk_devices"."status" <> 'active' or ("app"."kiosk_devices"."token_hash" is not null and "app"."kiosk_devices"."token_expires_at" is not null and "app"."kiosk_devices"."linked_at" is not null)

kiosk_devices_revoked_clean.name: kiosk_devices_revoked_clean
kiosk_devices_revoked_clean.value: "app"."kiosk_devices"."status" <> 'revoked' or ("app"."kiosk_devices"."token_hash" is null and "app"."kiosk_devices"."pairing_code_hash" is null)

charges_membership_check.name: charges_membership_check
charges_membership_check.value:
case when "app"."charges"."patient_membership_id" is null then
            "app"."charges"."benefit_year_start" is null and "app"."charges"."included_benefit_id" is null and "app"."charges"."membership_included_quantity" = 0
            and "app"."charges"."same_visit_labs_benefit_id" is null and "app"."charges"."discount_benefit_id" is null and "app"."charges"."membership_discount_cents" = 0
          else "app"."charges"."benefit_year_start" is not null end

charges_discount_bp_check.name: charges_discount_bp_check
charges_discount_bp_check.value: ("app"."charges"."discount_benefit_id" is null) = ("app"."charges"."membership_discount_bp" is null) and "app"."charges"."membership_discount_bp" between 1 and 10000

charges_source_refs_check.name: charges_source_refs_check
charges_source_refs_check.value: ("app"."charges"."source" = 'order') = ("app"."charges"."order_id" is not null and "app"."charges"."order_item_id" is not null) and ("app"."charges"."order_id" is null) = ("app"."charges"."order_item_id" is null)

charges_voided_check.name: charges_voided_check
charges_voided_check.value: ("app"."charges"."status" = 'voided') = ("app"."charges"."void_reason_enc" is not null and "app"."charges"."voided_by_membership_id" is not null and "app"."charges"."voided_at" is not null)

orders_lab_check.name: orders_lab_check
orders_lab_check.value: "app"."orders"."type" = 'lab' or ("app"."orders"."lab_provider_id" is null and "app"."orders"."suggested_lab_provider_id" is null)

orders_cancelled_check.name: orders_cancelled_check
orders_cancelled_check.value: ("app"."orders"."status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("app"."orders"."cancel_reason_enc" is not null and "app"."orders"."cancelled_by_membership_id" is not null and "app"."orders"."cancelled_at" is not null)

orders_started_check.name: orders_started_check
orders_started_check.value: ("app"."orders"."status" <> 'PENDING' or "app"."orders"."started_at" is null) and ("app"."orders"."status" not in ('IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') or "app"."orders"."started_at" is not null)

orders_completed_check.name: orders_completed_check
orders_completed_check.value: ("app"."orders"."status" = 'COMPLETED') = ("app"."orders"."completed_by_membership_id" is not null and "app"."orders"."completed_at" is not null)

membership_benefits_shape_check.name: membership_benefits_shape_check
membership_benefits_shape_check.value:
case when "app"."membership_benefits"."type" = 'included' then
            "app"."membership_benefits"."name_es" is not null and "app"."membership_benefits"."name_en" is not null and "app"."membership_benefits"."quantity_per_year" is not null
            and "app"."membership_benefits"."category" is null and "app"."membership_benefits"."discount_bp" is null
          else
            "app"."membership_benefits"."category" is not null and "app"."membership_benefits"."discount_bp" is not null
            and "app"."membership_benefits"."name_es" is null and "app"."membership_benefits"."name_en" is null and "app"."membership_benefits"."quantity_per_year" is null
            and not "app"."membership_benefits"."includes_same_visit_labs"
          end

patient_memberships_cancelled_check.name: patient_memberships_cancelled_check
patient_memberships_cancelled_check.value: ("app"."patient_memberships"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("app"."patient_memberships"."cancelled_on" is not null and "app"."patient_memberships"."cancellation" is not null)

patient_memberships_notice_check.name: patient_memberships_notice_check
patient_memberships_notice_check.value: ("app"."patient_memberships"."cancel_notice_on" is null) = ("app"."patient_memberships"."cancel_notice_by_membership_id" is null) and ("app"."patient_memberships"."cancel_notice_on" is null) = ("app"."patient_memberships"."benefits_end_date" is null)

payments_kind_fields_check.name: payments_kind_fields_check
payments_kind_fields_check.value:
("app"."payments"."kind" = 'payment' and "app"."payments"."amount_cents" > 0 and "app"."payments"."reverses_payment_id" is null and "app"."payments"."reason_enc" is null)
        or ("app"."payments"."kind" = 'void' and "app"."payments"."amount_cents" < 0 and "app"."payments"."reverses_payment_id" is not null and "app"."payments"."reason_enc" is not null)

receipts_fee_payment_check.name: receipts_fee_payment_check
receipts_fee_payment_check.value: "app"."receipts"."membership_fee_id" is null or "app"."receipts"."payment_id" is not null
